name: The Abyss
description: The formless deep between Hell and the created universe, ruled by the personified Chaos and Night. Classical borrowing (Hesiod's Theogony) rather than biblical content -- Genesis 1:2's 'without form, and void' gives only the barest hint. Satan must cross it to reach the new World.
power_structure: Ruled by Chaos and Night, with Orcus, Ades, and Demogorgon named in passing
story_hooks: Satan's journey from Hell's gate to the new World (Book II-III)
